main_issue: How to adapt the weeknight dinner rota for a month so Agent D can keep a vegetarian Purattasi while the four still share a cooked meal

A-B.evidence: A said all their dishes have meat (T3); B offered to swap days (T10); A accepted: 'swapping days works for me' (T11) and 'we'll just swap' (T15).

A-C.evidence: C said they can eat vegetarian while cooking one night a week (T5); A never addressed C. Both ended up supporting the swap, but only A said so, and C didn't speak after T5.

A-D.evidence: A objected to D cooking separately: 'the whole point was for all of us to eat together' (T7, T9). D then agreed to B's swap (T14) and A said 'we'll just swap' (T15).

B-C.evidence: Both were willing to eat vegetarian (T4, T5). B's swap was never addressed by C, who had not objected.

B-D.evidence: B offered to swap days or find a recipe (T10); D replied 'Okay, that works for me. Thanks for sorting that out' (T14).

C-D.evidence: C was fine eating vegetarian as long as C still cooks once a week (T5); D replied 'Okay, that's fine' (T6). C said nothing afterwards.
